```{r Libraries}
cutnumberint <- function(x, n = 5) {
  cut(
    x,
    breaks = quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1), na.rm = TRUE),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r Read and Save Epigenetics and Covariate Data}
# Initialize list to store results
Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates <- list()

# Loop through each element in Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants
for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {
  
  # 1. Extract the species name (between 4th and 5th underscores)
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  
  # 2. Add an underscore after the first character
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))
  
  # 3. Find all bedgraph files starting with species_prefix and ending with "bedgraph"
  species_files <- list.files(
    path = R_Data,
    pattern = paste0("^", species_prefix, ".*bedgraph$"),
    full.names = TRUE)
  
  #3.5. Subset for testing purposes
  #species_files <- species_files[1:10]
  
  # 4. Read each file separately, store in a named list
  file_list <- lapply(species_files, function(f) {
  tryCatch(
    read.table(f, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", skip = 1),
    error = function(e) NULL)  # skip unreadable files
  
  })
  
# 5. Name each element after its file (without path or extension)
names(file_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(species_files))

# 6. Store in main list
Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates[[species_name]] <- file_list
}
```

```{r Rename columns and Remove chr from Chromosome Names}
Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates <- lapply(Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates, function(file_list) {
  lapply(file_list, function(df) {
    if (!is.data.frame(df)) return(NULL)
    if (ncol(df) == 4) colnames(df) <- c("chrom","start","end","value")
    if (ncol(df) == 3) df <- df[,c("V1","V2","V2","V3")]
    colnames(df) <- c("chrom","start","end","value")
    df$chrom <- sub("^chr", "", df$chrom)  # remove "chr" from first column (chromosome)
    df$chrom <- sub("^Chr", "", df$chrom)  # remove "chr" from first column (chromosome)
   # set.seed(123)
  #  df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group <- cut_number(jitter(df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP), n = 5)
    df
  })
})
```

```{r Binning Genes into Mutation-Rate Quantiles}
Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants,
  function(df) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group = ifelse(
          UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP == 0, "0",
          ifelse(
            is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP), NA,
            as.character(cut_number(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, n = 5))
          )
        ),
        Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group_More = ifelse(
          UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP == 0, "0",
          ifelse(
            is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP), NA,
            as.character(cut_number(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, n = 12))
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      # Convert any scientific notation to decimal
      mutate(
        Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group = str_replace_all(
          Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group,
          "\\d+\\.?\\d*e[-+]?\\d+",
          ~ format(as.numeric(.x), scientific = FALSE, digits = 6)
        ),
        Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group_More = str_replace_all(
          Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group_More,
          "\\d+\\.?\\d*e[-+]?\\d+",
          ~ format(as.numeric(.x), scientific = FALSE, digits = 6)
        )
      ) %>%
      # ✅ Order numerically by lower bound, treat as ordered factor
      mutate(
        Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group = forcats::fct_reorder(
          factor(Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group, ordered = TRUE),
          as.numeric(str_extract(Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group, "(?<=\\[|\\()[^,]+")),
          .fun = min,
          .desc = FALSE
        ),
        Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group_More = forcats::fct_reorder(
          factor(Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group_More, ordered = TRUE),
          as.numeric(str_extract(Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group_More, "(?<=\\[|\\()[^,]+")),
          .fun = min,
          .desc = FALSE
        )
      )

    return(df)
  }
)

```

```{r Calculate Mean Epigenetic Values for Each Gene and Run Correlations}
# Empty List for Correlation Results
Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests <- list()
Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests <- list()

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {
  
  # 1️⃣ Get the VCF-like data for this speciesand subset for protein coding genes
  vcf_df <- subset(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]],
                   gene_biotype == "protein_coding")
  
  # 2️⃣ Extract species name (between 4th and 5th underscores)
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))
  
  # 3️⃣ Get corresponding epigenetic data
  epigenetic_list <- Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates[[species_name]]
 
  # 4️⃣ Convert gene coordinates to GRanges
  gene_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = vcf_df$CHROM,
    ranges = IRanges(start = vcf_df$start, end = vcf_df$end),
    strand = vcf_df$strand,
    dNdS_Group = vcf_df$Overall_dNdS_Group,
    mut_Group = vcf_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group
  )
  
  # 5️⃣ Loop through each epigenetic dataset for this species
  for (mark_name in names(epigenetic_list)) {
    mark_name_nospecies <- str_split(mark_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[3]
    mark_df <- epigenetic_list[[mark_name]]
    
    # Skip if the element is NULL
    if (is.null(mark_df)) next
    
    # Conver to GRanges object
    mark_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = mark_df$chrom,
      ranges = IRanges(start = mark_df$start, end = mark_df$end),
      value = mark_df$value
    )
    
    # Add strand information if needed
    if (mark_name %like% "plus") {
    strand(mark_gr) <- "+"
    }
    if (mark_name %like% "neg" |
        mark_name %like% "minus") {
    strand(mark_gr) <- "-"
    }
    
# # 5️⃣ (Bonus): Plot Metagene EnrichedHeatmap of Epigenetic Mark Around Gene Body
    body_epi_enrichment <- normalizeToMatrix(mark_gr,
                                             gene_gr,
                                             value_column = "value",
                                             extend = 1000,
                                             mean_mode = "weighted",
                                             w = 50,
                                             target_ratio = .7,
                                             smooth = FALSE,
                                             background = 0)
    #test <-
    #EnrichedHeatmap(body_epi_enrichment, name = "H3K9me3",
    # top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(lines = anno_enriched(gp = gpar(col = 2:4))),
    # column_title = "H3K9me3",
    # row_split = gene_gr$mut_Group)

    # Extract Enrichment Bins and Grouping Indexing Information
    mat <- as.matrix(body_epi_enrichment)
    groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$mut_Group)
    # Combine into a tidy data frame
    df <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(mut_group = groups) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -c(mut_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(mat))))
    # Summarise by dNdS group (mean + SE per position)
    MutationDensities <- df %>%
      group_by(mut_group, position) %>%
      summarise( mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

    # --- keep your original boundary logic exactly ---
    avg <- colMeans(mat)
    regionLength <- ((0.7 * 100) * length(avg)) / 100
    lengthEachSide <- (length(avg) - regionLength) / 2
    start <- lengthEachSide
    end <- length(avg) - lengthEachSide
    # Renaming NA dNdS Group
    #MutationDensities <- MutationDensities %>% mutate(dNds_Group = forcats::fct_explicit_na(group, na_level = "No Ortholog"))

    # --- Plot grouped by dNdS version ---
      MutationDensityPlot <-
      ggplot(MutationDensities,
             aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = mut_group, fill = mut_group)) +
      geom_line(size = .5) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(start, end), linetype = "dotted") +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
      title = paste("Enrichment of", mark_name_nospecies, "Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
      x = "Windows",
      y = paste("Mean", mark_name_nospecies),
      color = "Mutation \n Rate \n Quantile",
      fill = "Mutation \n Rate \n Quantile") +
      theme_bw() +
    theme(# Transparent backgrounds
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
          legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
          # Keep grid lines visible and black
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.2),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 6, colour = "white", hjust = .5),
          text = element_text(color = "white"),
          axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
          legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
          legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
          strip.text = element_text(color = "white")) +
          scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)

          # ggSaving
          ggsave(MutationDensityPlot,
             filename = paste0(R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
                               "Epigenetic_EnrichedHeatmaps/",
                               species_prefix,
                                "/GeneBody_Enrichment_of_", mark_name_nospecies, "_", element_name, ".png"),
             bg = "transparent",
             type="cairo",
             units = "cm",
             height = 8,
             width = 15,
             create.dir = TRUE,
             dpi = 2000)
          
      
    # 6️⃣ Merge by overlaps
    merged <- as.data.frame(mergeByOverlaps(gene_gr, mark_gr))
    
    # Compute mean of all overlapping values per gene range
    mean_df <- merged %>%
    group_by(gene_gr.seqnames, gene_gr.start, gene_gr.end) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    
    # Rename mean_value to indicate mean epigenetic modification type
    mean_mark_name <- paste("mean", mark_name_nospecies, sep = "_")
    colnames(mean_df) <- c("CHROM",
                           "start","end",
                           mean_mark_name)
    
    # 7️⃣ Attach new mean column back to the original VCF dataframe
    vcf_df <- merge(vcf_df, 
                    mean_df, 
                    by = c("CHROM", "start", "end"), 
                    all.x = TRUE)

  # Bin Genes by their chromatin mark
  vcf_df <- vcf_df %>%
  mutate(
    Overall_Mark_Group = cut_number(
      .data[[mean_mark_name]] + runif(n(), -1e-6, 1e-6),
      n = 5,
      ordered_result = TRUE
    )
  ) 


    
  # 8 Epigenetic Mark versus Mutation Rate
  # Run Spearman Correlations
  spearman_test <- 
    cor.test(vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
             vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]],
             method = "spearman")
  # Run Pearson Correlations
  pearson_test <- 
    cor.test(vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
             vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]],
             method = "pearson")
  
  # Save results into object
  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]] <- spearman_test
  Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]] <- pearson_test
  
  # Create a Scatter Plot
  p1 <- 
ggplot(
  data = subset(vcf_df, !is.na(vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]])),
  aes(x = !!sym(mean_mark_name),
      y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    labs(title = paste(mean_mark_name, "\n",
                       vcf_df$GENE_ID %>% 
                       unique() %>% length(), "Unique Protein Coding Genes with Mark Estimate"),
      subtitle = paste0("Spearman Correlation: ", 
                       "p Value = ", 
                       Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$p.value %>% signif(., digits = 5),", ",
                       "Coefficient = ", 
                       Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$estimate %>% signif(., digits = 5),
                       "\n",
                       "Pearson Correlation: ", 
                       "p Value = ", 
                       Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$p.value %>% signif(., digits = 5),", ",
                       "Coefficient = ", 
                       Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$estimate %>% signif(., digits = 5)),
      caption = "Line of best fit represents linear regression line produced using: geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", hjust = .5),
          text = element_text(color = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
          legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),

          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),

          strip.text = element_text(color = "black")) +

    # Save the plot — change width/height as needed
    ggsave(plot = p1,
```

```{r LASSO Hybrid Version}

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {
  
  # 1️⃣ Get the VCF-like data for this species
  element <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]]
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))
  
  # Subset to Only Covariate and Predictor Columns
  element_data <- element %>%
  dplyr::select(GENE_ID, 
         UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, 
         log2_Expression_Plus_One, 
         GC_Percentage,
         matches(c("H3K27me3$","H3K36me3$",
                 "HP1$","HPL2",
                 "H3K9me2$","H3K9me3$",
                 "H3K9ac$","H4K5ac$",
                 "H3K4me1$","H3K4me3",
                 #"plus$",
                 #"minus$",
                 "mean_replication")))
  
  # Working with complete cases for now
  element_data_complete_cases <-
  element_data[complete.cases(element_data) == TRUE,]

  # 1️⃣ Split into training and testing sets
  set.seed(69)
  index <- createDataPartition(element_data_complete_cases$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_df <- element_data_complete_cases[index, ]
  test_df  <- element_data_complete_cases[-index, ]

  # 2️⃣ Prepare matrices
  y_train <- train_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
  X_train <- scale(train_df[, setdiff(names(train_df), c("GENE_ID","UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"))])  # standardize
  y_test  <- test_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
  X_test  <- scale(test_df[, setdiff(names(test_df), c("GENE_ID","UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"))], 
                 center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"), 
                 scale  = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale"))  # use same scaling!

  # 3️⃣ Cross-validated LASSO on training set
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)

  # 4️⃣ Evaluate on test set
  pred_test <- predict(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min", newx = X_test)
  test_R2 <- cor(pred_test, y_test)^2
  test_RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y_test - pred_test)^2))

  test_R2
  test_RMSE

  # 5️⃣ Extract coefficients for interpretation
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")))
  coef_df$variable <- rownames(coef_df)
  colnames(coef_df)[1] <- "coefficient"
  coef_df <- subset(coef_df,
                    variable != "(Intercept)")
  coef_df$p_value <- ""
  coef_df$test <- "LASSO"

  # Plot LASSO Coefficients
  LASSO_Coefficients_Plot <-
  ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#1b9e77", "FALSE" = "#d95f02"),
    labels = c("Negative", "Positive")) +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Variable Importance for Mutation Rate",
    subtitle = paste0("Cross-validated LASSO (λ = ", round(test_R2, 5), ")"),
    x = "Predictor variable",
    y = "Standardized coefficient",
    fill = "Effect direction") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top")

  # Collapse Simple Correlation Results into Dataframe
  species_dfs <- lapply(Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests, function(species_list) {
  data.frame(
    variable = names(species_list),
    coefficient = sapply(species_list, function(x) x$estimate),  # Spearman correlation coefficient
    p_value = sapply(species_list, function(x) x$p.value),
    test = "Spearman",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
    
    # Combine Simple Correlation and LASSO Results
    combined_results <- 
      rbind(
      species_dfs[[species_prefix]],
      coef_df)
    # Set Test type as Factor to set ordering in plot
    combined_results$test <- factor(combined_results$test,
                                    levels = c("Spearman","LASSO"))
     
    # Plot Facetable Bar Plot
  LASSO_Spearman_Coefficients_Plot <-
  ggplot() +
    
  # The Spearman Plot
  geom_col(data = subset(combined_results,
                         test == "Spearman" &
                         variable %in% coef_df$variable),
  aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient),
  colour = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#003300", mid = "white", high = "orange", midpoint = 0) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
  
  # Reset Scales
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  
  # The LASSO Plot
  geom_col(data = subset(combined_results,
                         test == "LASSO" &
                         variable %in% coef_df$variable),
  aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient),
  colour = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#003300", mid = "white", high = "orange", midpoint = 0) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    
  # Theming
  facet_grid(~test, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = paste(species_prefix, "\n", "LASSO Variable Importance for Mutation Rate"),
    subtitle = paste0("Cross-validated LASSO (λ = ", round(test_R2, 5), ")"),
    x = "Predictor variable",
    y = "Standardized coefficient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", colour = "white", hjust = .5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, color = "white"),  # smaller labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "white"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "black", size = .3)) +    
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) 

  # Save the plot — change width/height as needed
    ggsave(plot = LASSO_Spearman_Coefficients_Plot,
       filename = paste0(R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/", 
                               "Expression_Methylation_LASSO_Plots/",
                               element_name, "_",
                               "_LASSO_Model_Plot",".png"),
      bg = "transparent",
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 5.5,
      height = 3.4,
      dpi = 1000)
  
}
```
